shared_params.Rd

Shared parameter documentation

Usage

shared_params(
  org,
  limit,
  token,
  repos,
  list,
  repo,
  env_var,
  file_name,
  try_common_locations
)

Arguments

org

A single character string giving the GitHub organisation or username whose repositories should be retrieved.

limit

The maximum number of repositories to retrieve. The default is `Inf`, which retrieves all available repositories.

token

A GitHub installation access token or personal access token. The default is `get_token()`, which returns a token generated by the GitHub App.

repos

A character vector of repository names, or a data frame with a column named `repo_name`. If a data frame is supplied without this column, an error is raised.

list

A list produced from the corresponding get_ function.

repo

A single repository name.

env_var

Character. The name of the keyring entry and/or environment variable holding the GitHub PAT. Defaults to `"GH_PAT"`.

file_name

string Detail the name of the file being retrieved and include the file extension, for example README.md or README.Rmd.

try_common_locations

try_common_locations If `TRUE` (the default), the function checks common alternative locations (`.github/`, `docs/`, lowercase) in addition to the exact path. Set to `FALSE` when the exact path is known.
